instruction: Go to the Chrome Web Store and add all the browser extensions that are specified in the recommendation list document.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions listed in the document. Evaluator verifies all extensions are installed by checking Chrome's extension manifest data.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file (chrome.py:1438-1472)
Metric correctly uses subset comparison to verify all expected extensions are installed (chrome.py:102-117)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all 5 extensions specified in the instruction
Correct data flow: getter reads manifest names -> metric compares expected vs installed using set subset
Edge cases handled: empty list returns 0.0, allows extra extensions, fails if any expected extension missing
